metadata.normalization: bounding-box center; longest extent equals one
metadata.normalOrientation: PCA normal's largest-magnitude component is positive
metadata.sourceIdPolicy: PLY source_id/vertex_id/id when supplied; otherwise original vertex index
metadata.curvatureDefinition: smallest local PCA eigenvalue / sum of eigenvalues
metadata.appearanceDefinition: linear-RGB inner-neighborhood mean versus outer-ring mean; Euclidean difference / sqrt(3)
metadata.featureScaling: divide by 95th percentile and clamp; maximum fallback for sparse features
metadata.confidenceDefinition: (middle - smallest PCA eigenvalue) / middle; small-neighborhood coverage factor
metadata.radiusDefinition: half the median distance to up to six nearest neighbors; minimum 0.00001
metadata.noiseDefinition: Gaussian displacement as a fraction of original longest extent; keyed to persistent source ID
